def format_oneline_trace(scope):
    segments = []
    scope = scope.maps[0]
    while LAST_CHILD_SCOPE in scope:
        child = scope[LAST_CHILD_SCOPE]
        # Get the spec type name
        spec_type = scope[Spec].__class__.__name__
        
        # Handle special cases for path information
        path_info = ""
        if hasattr(scope[Spec], '__ops__'):
            ops = scope[Spec].__ops__
            if len(ops) > 1:
                # Look for path components in ops
                path_parts = []
                i = 1
                while i < len(ops):
                    op, arg = ops[i], ops[i + 1]
                    if op == '.':
                        path_parts.append(str(arg))
                    elif op == '[':

                            path_parts.append(f"<{arg}>")
                        else:

                    elif op == 'P':
                        path_parts.append(str(arg))
                    elif op == '(':
                        path_parts.append(f"({arg})")
                    i += 2
                if path_parts:
                    path_info = ''.join(path_parts)
        
        # Combine type and path info
        if path_info:
            segments.append(f"{spec_type}{path_info}")
        else:
            segments.append(spec_type)
        
        # Move to parent scope
        scope = child.maps[0]
    else:
        # Add final scope
        spec_type = scope[Spec].__class__.__name__
        segments.append(spec_type)
    
    # Build the path representation with leading slash

        else:
